spec.title: Home · E-paper
spec.description: The Home dashboard's system board, laid out for a 1600×1200 black-and-white e-paper display. Capture the whole dashboard in kiosk mode with the light theme.
Render time, from the metrics store's clock. If it is old, the display has stopped refreshing; if it says metrics are unavailable, nothing below is current.
One row per system: the worst thing true of it right now, as on the Home dashboard's Systems board. Warning and Critical rows are inverted. Its query also feeds the Detail column.
